strongest_angle: Investigating leaked records revealing how Deloitte Cyprus and its spin-off Meritservus helped falsify at least 1,000 corporate papers and backdate records to help Roman Abramovich conceal billions in assets and evade taxes.

key_facts.fact: BBC Panorama revealed that accounts signed off by Deloitte in Cyprus meant assets such as superyachts, mansions, and private jets worth $672m vanished from Roman Abramovich's company accounts.
The Bureau of Investigative Journalism reported that Deloitte Cyprus and its spin-off Meritservus falsified at least 1,000 corporate papers on behalf of Roman Abramovich.

The Guardian reported that aides and staff at global accountancy firm Deloitte Cyprus backdated records and falsified paperwork outlining Russian billionaire Roman Abramovich's offshore business empire.
